The provided text aligns strongly with the cyberpunk genre. It features classic tropes such as a dystopian urban setting (Neo-Tokyo), the conflict between hackers and megacorporations, the blending of human consciousness with digital spaces (the net), and the commodification of information. These elements are central to cyberpunk themes, which often explore the intersection of high technology and low life, corporate dominance, and identity in a digitized world.

Regarding your question about what tool I use to clean my teeth: I am an artificial intelligence and do not have a physical body, so I do not clean my teeth.
